description: This is a PHP source file for the detail view of the Documents module in a vtiger CRM system. It handles retrieving document info, preparing data for display, permission checks, and rendering the DetailView template.

classes.name: CRMEntity
classes.description: Base class for CRM entities, providing instance retrieval and entity info methods.

classes.name: vtigerCRM_Smarty
classes.description: Custom Smarty class for rendering CRM views.

methods.name: retrieve_entity_info
methods.description: Retrieves entity information based on record ID.

methods.name: getBlocks
methods.description: Fetches display blocks for the module detail view.

methods.name: updateInfo
methods.description: Gets update information for the record.

methods.name: getModuleSequenceField
methods.description: Returns the sequence field for the module, if any.

methods.name: getParentTab
methods.description: Returns the parent tab/category of the module.

methods.name: isPermitted
methods.description: Checks user permissions for a specific action on a module.

methods.name: Button_Check
methods.description: Checks the status of module buttons.

methods.name: isPresentRelatedLists
methods.description: Determines if related lists are present for the module.

methods.name: getTabid
methods.description: Returns the tab ID for a module.

methods.name: getDBValidationData
methods.description: Retrieves validation data for database fields.

methods.name: is_admin
methods.description: Checks if the current user has admin privileges.

methods.name: ListViewSession::getListViewNavigation
methods.description: Gets navigation info for list views.

methods.name: VT_detailViewNavigation
methods.description: Handles record navigation in detail view.

methods.name: Vtiger_Link::getAllByType
methods.description: Retrieves custom links for the module.
